nc.description: A 3D rendering shows a central white cylinder partially enclosed by a grey shell, with a grey ring suspended above it, all surrounded by a geometric framework of grey beams.
Multiple grey arrows converge into the left side of a vise-like object, while a chain of small blocks emerges and splits from its right side.
An assembly of molded grey and silver geometric shapes rests on a flat circular base against a white background.
A light grey 3D-rendered object features a fan-like cluster of blocks attached to a central frame that houses a glowing, cracked wedge, with a cylindrical knob extending from the opposite side.
A large, faceted white object is centered on a white background, surrounded by smaller gray geometric shapes arranged in a radiating, symmetrical pattern.

vc.description: A clear, textured container is secured within a split mechanical fixture by padded side clamps, with a threaded top component positioned directly above it.
A grey mechanical assembly featuring linkages, springs, and a gear is expelling flat, circular discs from a threaded opening.
A close-up view displays a grey mechanical assembly featuring two coiled springs on cylindrical shafts connected by a central, ribbed component.
A mechanical hinge connects a surface with a metallic paw-print design to another surface featuring a circular dial and a glowing, cracked round element.
A white handgun frame is surrounded by a symmetrical arrangement of plastic components, spools, and piles of pellets on a white background.
